item.title: DOXA Industry
item.description: DOXA Industry Milena Salazar Wed, 04/28/2021 - 15:49 DOXA Industry brings together a diverse community of filmmakers and industry professionals to discuss the art and craft of non-fiction storytelling. Through a series of workshops, roundtable discussions, masterclasses and networking events, we invite filmmakers at all levels of experience to engage in vital conversations while building the skills and connections needed to propel their projects forward. item.title: Support DOXA Filmmakers and Give Aeroplan Points
item.description: Support DOXA Filmmakers and Give Aeroplan Points Jasmine Monton Fri, 02/16/2024 - 14:04 From now until April 1, 2024, Aeroplan members can send critical filmmakers to Western Canada’s largest documentary festival. DOXA Documentary Film Festival aims high to collect 100,000 donated Aeroplan points. Over the past 22 seasons, DOXA has presented over 1,500 films from 50+ countries, giving Vancouver audiences and beyond perspectives that are shaping our world today.
